families.initial_body: For each claim, choose the first source and output an array of objects with id, value, source. With no source use value "unknown" and source null. Read input.json and write result.json; preserve original files.

families.initial_body: Read input.json. For records whose path ends with exactly lowercase .txt, create copies under copies/ using the same filename and uppercase content. Write result.json containing the sorted array of copied paths. Preserve all original files.
families.feedback: From now on, the text-copy workflow must recognize .txt extensions case-insensitively, including .TXT. Preserve original filenames in copies/ and uppercase only the copied content. result.json is a sorted array of copied relative paths. This is a lasting reusable rule; preserve unrelated instructions.
